data.one_liner: Port of Google's android-maps-utils for spherical geometry, polylines, and math in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides core geometry, geodesy, and math utilities ported from Google's android-maps-utils library. Includes calculations for distances, headings, bounding boxes, polyline encoding/decoding, and Douglas-Peucker simplification.
use_when: You need to calculate distances, headings, or areas between geographical coordinates.
You need to encode or decode Google polyline strings in a Dart or Flutter application.
You need spatial calculations like point-in-polygon or path simplification without heavy map rendering dependencies.
avoid_when: You need a full interactive map widget (use a mapping package instead).
You only need basic non-geographical math operations.
strengths: Exact algorithmic parity with Google's android-maps-utils library.
Cross-platform support including mobile, web, and desktop.
weaknesses: Only a small subset (3 out of 78) of the full android-maps-utils classes have been ported so far.

alternatives.name: latlong2
alternatives.why_pick_it: A pure Dart library for distance and geometry calculations often used alongside flutter_map.
